course_name_original: Schwerpunkt: Modellbildung und Simulation in der Dynamik (SP 61)
course_name_en: Focus: Modeling and Simulation in Dynamics (SP 61)

learning_outcomes.text: The specialization imparts modeling competence in dynamics, thus continuing the compulsory subjects of dynamics.
Analytical methods for treating and investigating dynamic systems are covered in the courses.
The simulation of these systems enables graduates to conduct, critically evaluate, and interpret simulation studies in typical application fields of dynamics.

syllabus_topics: Methods for describing the kinematics of rigid body systems
Methods for deriving the equations of motion of rigid body systems
Analytical methods for solving equations of motion of dynamic systems
Mathematical methods for solving equations of motion of dynamic systems
Numerical integration for approximate solutions of equations of motion
